<reason>PRO won the methodology clash. CON showed small samples are weak and demanded large stable-from-birth proof, forcing the concession Not in the form those files allow. But PRO showed CON's large-file gaps count divorce/recoupling wreckage as same-sex effect and never isolated parental sex, especially via adoptive/donor parallel. Certain legal injury vs unproven average harm gave cleaner policy weighing.</reason>
<best_rebuttal>PRO's confound + adoptive/donor parallel: large snapshots swallow breakup then name it two mothers/fathers, and different-sex non-biological families share the missing-parent pathway, so CON never isolated sex.</best_rebuttal>
